engine_result.question: What is the current price of a US Postal Service First-Class Mail 1-ounce letter stamp as of late 2026?

findings.text: USPS official site states First-Class Mail Forever stamps cost $0.82 (the current 1 oz price) and will never expire even if postage rates go up. (website: https://www.usps.com/ship/first-class-mail.htm · $0.82)
USPS Postage Rates & Prices page lists First-Class Mail at $0.82 at the Post Office, or from $0.621 for Commercial Pricing. (website: https://www.usps.com/business/prices.htm · $0.82; $0.621)

USPS Newsroom announcement (dated April 9, 2026) states USPS recommended new prices for July including a 4-cent increase in the price of a First-Class Mail Forever stamp from 78 cents to 82 cents. (website: https://about.usps.com/newsroom/national-releases/2026/0409-usps-recommends-new-prices-for-july.htm · 78 cents; 82 cents)

MPA guide reports confirmed July 12, 2026 USPS rate changes per Notice 123, listing First-Class postcard retail single piece at $0.65 (up from $0.61) and First-Class presort letters automation 1 oz ranging $0.621 to $0.707. (website: https://www.mailpro.org/post/usps-postage-rates-2026/ · $0.65; $0.61; $0.621; $0.707; $0.453; $0.478; $0.495)

Stamps.com help article notes standard Post Office retail stamps increased to $0.82, while printing 1 oz First-Class postage through Stamps.com qualifies for the Metered Letter rate of $0.78. (website: https://help.stamps.com/hc/en-us/articles/20820467721371-USPS-Rate-Changes-2026 · $0.82; $0.78)

USPS FAQ page states that for the January 2026 price change, the price of a stamp to mail a 1-ounce single-piece First-Class letter will not increase, as USPS decided to forgo a price change for First-Class Mail postage and other Market Dominant services at that time. (website: https://faq.usps.com/s/article/2026-Postage-Price-Change)

National Postal Museum historical table of U.S. domestic letter rates lists rate increases through June (table cut off), with the last fully shown rate being 34 cents effective January 7, 2001. (website: https://postalmuseum.si.edu/us-domestic-letter-rates · 34 cents)

USPS 'Rates for Domestic Letters Since 1863' historical table lists postage per ounce as 34 cents (Jan 7, 2001), 63 cents (Jan 22, 2023), and 66 cents (July 9, 2023), with a surcharge for non-standard envelope sizes since July 15, 1979. (website: https://about.usps.com/who/profile/history/domestic-letter-rates-since-1863.htm · 34; 63; 66)

Postal Explorer Notice 123 PDF lists various domestic fees, including Address Correction Service fees such as $1.00 per manual notice issued and $0.22 per electronic notice for First-Class Mail. (website: https://pe.usps.com/cpim/ftp/manuals/dmm300/notice123.pdf · $1.00; 0.22; 0.50; 0.17)

Postal Explorer page indicates a 'Time-Limited 2026 Price Change' Notice 123 PDF finalized 09/18/2026 and corresponding SKU Price Files finalized 08/25/2026. (website: https://pe.usps.com/PriceChange · 09/18/2026; 08/25/2026)

USPS Newsroom announced a temporary price change for the 2026 holiday shipping season, including a $0.50 increase for Zones 1-4, 0-3 lbs and a $0.80 increase (service unspecified in excerpt). (website: https://about.usps.com/newsroom/national-releases/2026/0825-usps-announces-temporary-price-change-for-2026-holiday-shipping-season.htm · $0.50; $0.80)

Pitney Bowes USPS rate change overview page lists a First-Class Mail figure of $1.75 (context/service not specified in excerpt). (website: https://www.pitneybowes.com/us/postal-information/usps-rate-change-overview.html · $1.75)
